response.original_title: 御殿坂くるみ キミ、10代、恋の予感
response.overview: A hot new face on the radar! The adorable Kurumi Gotenzaka — a teenager with a genuine baby face — makes a triumphant debut in the wildly popular series billed as the gateway for teen gravure idols. With her black hair and star-quality looks, Kurumi is full of drive: "I want to become a famous gravure idol!" Her smile is fresh-picked fruit, the school uniform suits her far too well, and her clingy little-sister charm — set against soft, juicy white skin and a flawlessly smooth, top-grade crotch shot — makes her impossible to resist. On her very first shoot she blushes her way through, throwing herself into even the boldest poses; perhaps a little too hard, as her small fingers and the gaps in her costume end up springing a few surprises. A much-watched newcomer you won't be able to take your eyes off — right from her very debut.
response.title: Kurumi Gotenzaka: Kimi, Juudai, Koi no Yokan
